Name: AutoHoe
Author: YunHikari
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
[list]
[*]This mod provides automated assistance with hoe work, helping you complete various types of work.
[*]Automatically digs up Artifact Spots and Ginger.
[*]Excavates dirt in the mines, aiding you in finding Cave Carrots.
[*]Marks dig areas to support planning farm fields.
[/list]
[b]How to use[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Equip your Hoe.
[*]Approach diggable targets.
[/list][list]
[*]When the Hoe is equipped, [color=#6d9eeb][b]right-clicking[/b][/color] marks the digging area.
[/list]
[b]Configs[/b]
[list]
[*]You can customize this mod using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/28974/28974-1730364161-1401541841.gif[/img]
High-efficiency Cave Carrot hunting.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/28974/28974-1730364325-154512597.gif[/img]
Digging up Artifact Spots while passing by.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/28974/28974-1730364499-1178392774.gif[/img]
Mark designated digging areas to make planning your farm easier!
